topic: Internet outage frequency/duration (Ofcom, ComReg, CRTC, FCC) and cheapest mobile data plans by market

findings.what: UK (Ofcom) power-related outage share and typical duration, fixed/mobile networks, 2020-2022
findings.value: 25.3% of incidents power-related; 90% of power outages last 3 minutes to 3 hours
findings.quote: between 2020 and 2022, 693 out of 2735 (25.3%) of reported incidents for fixed and mobile networks were caused by power-related issues... 90% of power outages last between 3 minutes and 3 hours.

findings.what: Ireland (ComReg) average annual outage hours: copper vs fibre broadband
findings.quote: Users of services over copper networks report experiencing an average of 45 hours of outage per year, against 16 hours for fibre users.

findings.what: Ireland (ComReg) Storm Barra (2021) impact on network, all 26 counties
findings.quote: In 2021, Storm Barra damaged network infrastructure in all 26 counties of the Republic of Ireland resulting in almost 1.5m user hours lost.

findings.what: Canada (CRTC) new outage-reporting requirement: carriers must report major outages within 2 hours, full report within 14 days (effective since March 8, 2023)
findings.value: report within 2 hours; full report within 14 days
findings.quote: The Commission directs all Canadian carriers to report major service outages to the Commission within two hours of when the carrier becomes aware of such an outage, and to file a comprehensive report with the Commission within 14 days following the outage, with this direction taking effect on March 8, 2023.

findings.what: US (FCC) Measuring Broadband America program: scope and limitation re: outage data
findings.value: measures speed/latency/packet loss via volunteer routers; not currently structured to capture large-scale outage events directly
findings.quote: the MBA test servers could see larger-scale outages instantaneously but are currently not set up to do so according to the available documentation.

findings.what: US cheapest Mint Mobile (T-Mobile network) plan: price and data allowance
findings.quote: Mint Mobile's 6 GB Plan has a regular monthly cost of $15 per month and comes with 6 GB of data per month.

findings.what: UK cheapest giffgaff plan: price and data allowance
findings.quote: Giffgaff SIM only deals start at just £6 per month... The £6/month no-contract plan includes 2GB of 5G data

findings.what: Ireland cheapest 48 Mobile plan: price and data allowance
findings.quote: 48 Mobile plans start from €10.99 per month in Ireland... Plan: Student 100GB, Price: €10.99/month, Data: 100GB

findings.what: Mexico cheapest Telcel Amigo plan: price and data allowance
findings.quote: The Amigo Plan at $10 USD (170 MXN) includes around 2 GB of data, unlimited calls within Mexico, and free WhatsApp usage.

findings.what: Canada cheapest widely-cited plan (Public Mobile/Telus network), 20GB+ tier
findings.value: 25/month for 20GB+ (various budget carriers: Public Mobile, Koodo, Lucky Mobile, Chatr, PC Mobile, SpeakOut, Fizz)
findings.quote: the cheapest cell phone plans with 20 GB or more data in Canada start at just $25/month

findings.what: Canada Koodo cheapest plan (lowest absolute price, low data), as of Oct 2026
findings.quote: As of October 2, 2026, Koodo's cheapest cell phone plan was priced at $37.50 per month, offering 2 GB of data.
